# Baby v0.35.1 - Table of Contents

> Bushbaby Automated Bamboo Yields

## Modules

- [Baby](https://baby.hexdocs.pm/Baby.md): Bushbaby Automated Bamboo Yields
- [Baby.Application](https://baby.hexdocs.pm/Baby.Application.md): By design the `Baby` server does not start automatically.
- [Baby.Connection](https://baby.hexdocs.pm/Baby.Connection.md): State machine connection handler

- [Baby.Connection.Registry](https://baby.hexdocs.pm/Baby.Connection.Registry.md): A process registry for `Baby.Connection`
- [Baby.Log.Acceptor](https://baby.hexdocs.pm/Baby.Log.Acceptor.md): Disk queue for incoming bamboo data
- [Baby.Log.Writer](https://baby.hexdocs.pm/Baby.Log.Writer.md): Stand alone writer for the `Baobab` log store

- [Baby.Monitor](https://baby.hexdocs.pm/Baby.Monitor.md): Cutely and unhelpfully named.
A GenServer managing periodic `cryout` activity

- [Baby.Protocol](https://baby.hexdocs.pm/Baby.Protocol.md): Protocol implementation

- [Baby.Util](https://baby.hexdocs.pm/Baby.Util.md): Utility functions for use across the codebase
